claims.text: Sapede and Araujo describe distinct Soyo and Ngoyo institutions and intermediaries. Mavungo’s reprint separately names Capelo and contracting local roles in the 1885 protection, customs and land terms; its individual signature roster is cropped. The thesis’s later governor-landing account is an attributed operation, not identical to treaty prescription. Neither the terms nor that landing erase local institutions, establish universal consent or settle present territorial title. Originals remain uncollated.
